robustness_definition.definition: robust_score = sum_k w_k * (abs(log10(y_k/c_k)) + q_k*r)^2, with q_eta80=q_eta120=1 and q_ratio=2; this is the exact worst case of the nominal objective over the frozen rectangular log-space interval
robustness_definition.rationale: Preferred windows define the optimization target, not a certification envelope. Full preferred-window containment gives zero robust candidates in this frozen space and is therefore not used. Broad windows are retained as the functional admissibility envelope under uncertainty; within that admissible set, robustness is ranked by the parameter-free worst-case extension of the nominal objective. No uncertainty weight is tuned and the nominal property weights are inherited unchanged.
